tweaks.name: Run detected games on the high-performance GPU
tweaks.why: Sets Windows' per-app graphics preference to 'High performance' for each detected game (Tekken 8, VALORANT, CS2). Matters on PCs that also have integrated graphics enabled (most Ryzen 7000/9000 and Intel CPUs); harmless otherwise. Same switch as Settings > Display > Graphics.

tweaks.name: CS2: write autoexec.cfg with an fps cap (asks for the value)
tweaks.why: Writes a clearly marked block into game\csgo\cfg\autoexec.cfg: fps_max (a capped rate gave much better 1% lows than unlimited in community testing) plus a commented-out frame pacing tweak to test yourself. Anything already in your autoexec is kept; undo removes only this block.
